The '''capture of Cygnus Staff''' was an operation committed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to capture staff from [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]].

==Prelude==
After [[Rescue of Sian Tevv|rescuing]] [[Sian Tevv/Legends|Sian Tevv]] the Alliance and the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] began to formulate a plan to destroy the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] [[Invincible (Strike Fear)|''Invincible'']] and end [[Operation Strike Fear]] permanently.

The first step was to capture some staff belonging to the Cygnus corporation so that they could acquire codes to masquerade as a supply ship on a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class T-4a shuttle]]. They found the opportunity at a test site where they were conducting tests on their latest fighter, the [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing]].

==The Battle==
[[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] in a [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]], along with a wingman, were launched first. They cleared the small fighter defences that were only in the way and Farlander scanned the [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transports]] ''[[Kappa]]'' and ''[[Lambda (disambiguation)|Lambda]]'' 1 and 2 to find the staff in ''Kappa'' with the defences cleared a Rebel transport [[Lightning (Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport)|''Lightning'']] arrived and boarded the transport ''Kappa'' while Farlander destroyed any remaining [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|Interceptors]] and destroyed the two [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|freighters]] ''[[Dock]]'' to stop any more fighters and the ''Lambda'' transports. The ''Lightning'' captured the staff and jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] with the two fighters following suit.

==Aftermath==
The staff "provided" the Alliance the codes to board the Star Destroyer without suspicion. The second step was to plant an extremely powerful explosive into the ''Invincible'', which required a massive [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|Nuclear bomb]] from the Empire's own arsenal. The opportunity for one presented itself when a freighter named ''[[Gafra]]'' was stranded by a [[Capture of the Gafra|rebel attack]].
